tests.name: skip_indentation_spaces_parsing
tests.intent: Verify that parsing pretty-printed JSON with various counts of space indentation works correctly via contiguous span input.

tests.name: skip_indentation_with_tabs_and_newlines
tests.intent: Check behavior when indentation contains mixed tabs, carriage returns, and spaces following newlines.

tests.name: skip_indentation_short_input
tests.intent: Ensure input with very few bytes remaining after a newline does not trigger out-of-bounds reads in skip_indentation.

tests.name: skip_indentation_exact_eight_bytes
tests.intent: Test indentation running exactly 8 bytes of spaces after a newline.

tests.name: skip_indentation_multiple_lines_deep
tests.intent: Probe nested pretty-printed structures where multiple consecutive lines have different space indentation lengths.

tests.name: skip_indentation_error_position
tests.intent: Verify that parsing syntax errors occurring after indented lines still reports accurate location context.

tests.name: skip_indentation_trailing_spaces_only
tests.intent: Test behavior when a newline is followed only by spaces up to the end of the input stream.

tests.name: skip_indentation_non_contiguous_stream
tests.intent: Confirm that non-contiguous stream inputs bypass the bulk skip optimization safely and produce correct outputs.

tests.name: skip_indentation_zero_spaces
tests.intent: Check newline followed immediately by non-space characters (0 space indent).

tests.name: skip_indentation_large_indent
tests.intent: Probe indentation exceeding multiple 8-byte words of contiguous spaces.

tests.name: skip_indentation_with_comments
tests.intent: Test whitespace and comment handling when lines contain leading spaces followed by comments under accept_comments configuration.

tests.name: skip_indentation_sax_parse_api
tests.intent: Exercise low-level sax_parse entry point with contiguous span input and pretty-printed content.

tests.name: skip_indentation_vector_char_input
tests.intent: Parse pretty-printed JSON provided as a std::vector<char> container to fully exercise bulk_scan requirements.

tests.name: skip_indentation_empty_input
tests.intent: Verify behavior of lexer skipping on empty string input.

tests.name: skip_indentation_only_newlines
tests.intent: Check input consisting solely of multiple newlines and spaces.

tests.name: skip_indentation_accept_method
tests.intent: Validate json::accept() performance path with indented contiguous inputs.

tests.name: skip_indentation_ubjson_fallback
tests.intent: Ensure binary formats like UBJSON ignore text indentation paths while successfully parsing or rejecting input.

tests.name: skip_indentation_consecutive_newlines
tests.intent: Test parsing when multiple consecutive newline characters appear without characters in between.

tests.name: skip_indentation_ordered_json
tests.intent: Verify skip_indentation works identically with nlohmann::ordered_json container types.

tests.name: skip_indentation_unclosed_object
tests.intent: Test error handling on pretty-printed JSON that terminates abruptly mid-indentation.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercise count_trailing_zeros portable fallback path if compiled under non-GCC/non-clang compilers, or simulate fallback code patterns via macro detection/compiler configuration flags if applicable.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Test trailing zero count for a single-bit 64-bit value via internal path integration by parsing indentation with non_space ending at specific byte boundaries.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercise count_trailing_zeros through multi-line indentation ending with different non-space bit patterns.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Trigger skip_indentation with exactly 8 spaces on a line before a token to ensure non_space detection uses count_trailing_zeros correctly.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Test 16 spaces indentation after newline to force multiple 8-byte chunks processing inside skip_indentation and trailing zeros calculation on partial words.

tests.name: skip_indentation_ubjson_fallback_fixed
tests.intent: Ensure binary formats like UBJSON ignore text indentation paths while successfully parsing or rejecting input.
